name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The script used the OpenAI Python SDK with the Fireworks-compatible endpoint, and the model responded with "¡Hola!" to the prompt "Say hello in Spanish".
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to substitute an available model (`accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2`) to get a successful response. Everything else followed the docs exactly.
